description: Return raw per-project audit artifacts for all detected supported roots and report unsupported roots. Use when a downstream specialist tool needs project-audits/v1; for a complete first-pass review, prefer analyze_repository.

changedPaths.description: Optional repository-relative source paths to limit target selection inside detected projects.

excludeProjectRoots.description: Optional exact project roots or subtree patterns such as examples/** to exclude before auditing detected projects.

goarch.description: Explicit GOARCH for bounded Go build-constraint evaluation.

goos.description: Explicit GOOS for bounded Go build-constraint evaluation.

tags.description: Optional custom Go build tags passed to the target-aware verification command.
